Hollywood Reporter on Instagram: "Law Roach responds to going viral after revealing Zendaya and Tom Holland were married at the #Oscars.

Watch the Oscars LIVE on ABC"
content.text: Never miss a post from hollywoodreporterSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Law Roach responds to going viral after revealing Zendaya and Tom Holland were married at the #Oscars.Watch the Oscars LIVE on ABCI think a conversation was had😮He did what he shouldn't so they cut his hairNo, I think he did what he was supposed to do. He planted the seed for all the Zendaya talk as she promotes her movie about a WEDDING. People can be so denseZendaya got him all the way together 😂😂😂😂Something tells me those were not his news to announce and they probably ripped him a new one (if he didn’t get fired altogether). I know I would.Finally she checked him….. it was time….Yall think z checked him….meanwhile he said it to generate buzz surrounding her new movie duh….why would reveal that info without talking to Z firstThere’s nothing else to add. Law said what he said, I can’t imagine he would leak that if he hadn’t been told he’s allowed to, but there isn’t anything else to talk about other than the wedding happened.In other words…he did what he came to do and now they(the whole camp) has moved on lol. Love him and all that group doesZendaya made sure his wig ain't wigging today. That's enough punishment I'd say😁🤣They can never make me hate Law 😂 flat outZendaya said speak on it again if you want to 😂
